verdicts.line: You roar. Everyone who witnesses it is frightened, whatever you intend.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: NPCs within **witness radius R (~6 tiles)** of the line take an unconditional Fear push (~2.8) regardless of flame color
verdicts.reason: Missing the mechanical consequence that witness radius is bounded (~6 tiles) and that roaring outside this radius is free terrain work.
verdicts.correction: You roar. Everyone within witness radius is frightened, whatever you intend — beyond that, free terrain.

verdicts.line: Roar. All who witness the line are pushed to fear — the flame's color does not protect them.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: NPCs within **witness radius R (~6 tiles)** of the line take an unconditional Fear push (~2.8) regardless of flame color
verdicts.reason: States the unconditional fear push and explicitly names that flame color offers no protection, which is the core mechanical consequence.

verdicts.line: This is Roar. It frightens everyone who sees it, no matter what the flame carries.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: you roar and the earth shatters ahead
verdicts.reason: Says 'everyone who sees it' without the witness-radius boundary that makes roaring tactically interesting.
verdicts.correction: This is Roar. It frightens everyone within witness radius, no matter what the flame carries — roar beyond that and only stone breaks.

verdicts.line: You can roar a path through stone. Everyone who witnesses the break feels fear.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: Shatters a line of tiles — fast traversal / path creation. NPCs within **witness radius R (~6 tiles)** of the line take an unconditional Fear push
verdicts.reason: Names both the terrain effect (path through stone) and the witness-bounded fear consequence in instrumentation register.

verdicts.line: Roar shatters the ground ahead. Witness it and you are frightened — your alignment, theirs, nothing stops this.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: NPCs within **witness radius R (~6 tiles)** of the line take an unconditional Fear push (~2.8) regardless of flame color
verdicts.reason: Explicitly states that alignment (yours and theirs) does not stop the fear push, which is the core tactical constraint.

verdicts.line: When you roar, the earth breaks and all who see it are afraid. The flame cannot change this.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: NPCs within **witness radius R (~6 tiles)** of the line
verdicts.reason: Says 'all who see it' without acknowledging the witness radius boundary that defines roar's tactical range.
verdicts.correction: When you roar, the earth breaks and all within witness radius are afraid — the flame cannot change this, distance can.

verdicts.line: Roar. The line frightens every witness regardless of what you feel or what they do.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: Shatters a line of tiles — fast traversal / path creation
verdicts.reason: Omits the terrain-breaking effect entirely, reducing roar to only its fear consequence when it is dual-purpose.
verdicts.correction: Roar shatters a line of ground. Every witness is frightened regardless of what you feel or what they do.

verdicts.line: You roar and the stone splits. Fear reaches everyone in sight of the break, even those already aligned to you.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: the roar is the *save* (clears the flag, §2.3)
verdicts.reason: Names stone-splitting, witness-bounded fear, and that even aligned followers are frightened — the exception (hope-burned save) is advanced knowledge, correctly omitted here.
